news.title: Grand Inauguration of Excellentia Arts Fiesta 2026 Celebrated with Splendor
news.summary: The grand cultural extravaganza commenced with majestic fanfare, flag hoisting, and inspiring inaugural addresses honoring the artistic heritage of Ma'din School of Excellence.

news.title: Team Bukhara Takes Early Lead in A-Zone Literary & Recitation Duels
news.summary: With phenomenal performances in Quran Recitation and Elocution, Bukhara surged ahead, closely followed by Undulus and Samarkhand in a nail-biting point contest.

news.title: Spectacular Duff Muttu & Kolkkali Performances Mesmerize Capacity Crowd
news.summary: The Main Stadium was packed to the rafters as the four houses delivered thunderous percussion rhythms, traditional sync, and acrobatic choreography.

news.title: Arabic Calligraphy & Watercolor Exhibition Unveiled at Central Pavilion
news.summary: Visitors and jury members praised the breathtaking Arabic script masterpieces and creative canvas illustrations crafted by talented students across all zones.

news.title: Choral March & Anthem Grand Finale Scheduled for Tomorrow Night
news.summary: All four houses are fine-tuning their vocal harmonies and formations for the prestigious General Category Anthem trophy.

news.title: Audit Committee Discrepancy Reporting System Operational 24/7
news.summary: Team managers and house captains can submit immediate score or participant correction queries through the portal's integrated discrepancy audit module.

items.subject: Discover The Unseen - A Poem on Hidden Horizons
items.textContent:
Echoes of the Unseen Soul

In the quiet depths beneath the ocean blue,
Where whispered dreams in silent stillness grew...

"Art is the mirror of the unseen world."
